explanation.summary: Unit 2 membahas Present Simple (I do) yang digunakan untuk menyatakan fakta umum (things in general/true in general), situasi permanen, serta kebiasaan atau tindakan berulang (how often we do things). Untuk subjek orang ketiga tunggal (he/she/it), kata kerja ditambahkan akhiran -s atau -es. Pada kalimat negatif dan tanya, kata kerja bantu do/does wajib digunakan (don't/doesn't + kata kerja dasar V1; Do/Does + subjek + kata kerja dasar V1). Murphy menekankan bahwa pada pertanyaan dengan kata tanya (wh-questions), auxiliary do/does harus mendahului subjek (misalnya 'What does this word mean?', bukan 'What means this word?'). Ketika 'do' menjadi kata kerja utama, auxiliary 'do/does' tetap harus hadir (contoh: 'What do you do?' dan 'He doesn't do anything'). Selain itu, kata kerja performatif seperti promise, apologise, suggest, insist, recommend, dan refuse digunakan dalam bentuk Present Simple ('I promise...', bukan 'I'm promising').
explanation.pattern: (+) S (I/we/you/they) + V1 | S (he/she/it) + V1(-s/-es) ; (-) S (I/we/you/they) + don't + V1 | S (he/she/it) + doesn't + V1 ; (?) (Wh-) + do/does + S + V1 ...? ; Performative: S + V_performative (promise/apologise/suggest/insist/refuse/agree)
key_points: Untuk kebiasaan dan fakta umum
Subjek he/she/it menambah -s/-es; negatif dan tanya memakai do/does

explanation.summary: Unit 3 membahas perbedaan mendasar antara Present Continuous (I am doing) dan Present Simple (I do). Present Continuous digunakan untuk tindakan yang sedang berlangsung pada atau di sekitar waktu berbicara (tindakan belum selesai) serta situasi sementara (temporary situations) yang hanya berlangsung untuk waktu singkat. Sebaliknya, Present Simple digunakan untuk fakta umum, hal-hal yang terjadi berulang kali/kebiasaan, dan situasi permanen (permanent situations) yang berlangsung lama. Selain itu, unit ini membedakan penggunaan 'always': 'I always do' bermakna melakukan sesuatu setiap saat/setiap kali (rutinitas biasa), sedangkan 'I'm always doing' bermakna melakukan sesuatu terlalu sering atau lebih sering dari biasanya, yang sering kali digunakan untuk menyatakan kejengkelan atau kritik terhadap kebiasaan buruk.
explanation.pattern: Present Continuous (aksi saat ini / sementara): S + am/is/are + V-ing | Present Simple (fakta umum / permanen / kebiasaan): S + V1(-s/-es) | Always: 'S + always + V1(-s/-es)' (setiap kali dilakukan) vs 'S + am/is/are + always + V-ing' (terlalu sering / mengeluh)
key_points: Continuous untuk hal yang sedang terjadi atau sementara
Simple untuk kebiasaan dan fakta umum

explanation.summary: Unit 7 berfokus pada Present Perfect Simple (have/has + past participle). Tenses ini digunakan terutama saat suatu tindakan di masa lalu memiliki dampak atau keterkaitan langsung dengan kondisi saat ini (connection with now), atau ketika menyampaikan kabar/informasi baru (new information). Terdapat pembedaan makna penting antara 'gone to' (masih berada di tempat tujuan atau sedang di perjalanan ke sana) dan 'been to' (sudah pergi dan kini telah kembali pulang). Selain itu, unit ini menjelaskan tiga adverb penting: 'just' (baru saja/beberapa saat lalu), 'already' (sudah/lebih cepat dari yang diperkirakan), serta 'yet' (sampai saat ini; hanya dipakai di kalimat tanya dan kalimat negatif, umumnya diletakkan di akhir klausa).
explanation.pattern: Positive: Subject + have/has + (just/already) + Past Participle (V3); Negative: Subject + have/has + not + Past Participle (V3) ... (+ yet); Question: Have/Has + Subject + (just) + Past Participle (V3) ... (+ yet)?

explanation.summary: Unit 10 membandingkan penggunaan Present Perfect Continuous dan Present Perfect Simple. Present Perfect Continuous (have/has been + -ing) berfokus pada aktivitas atau proses itu sendiri serta durasi keberlangsungannya (menjawab 'how long'), tanpa memedulikan apakah aktivitas tersebut sudah tuntas atau belum. Sebaliknya, Present Perfect Simple (have/has + past participle) berfokus pada hasil akhir dari tindakan yang telah selesai, khususnya untuk menyatakan seberapa banyak kuantitas atau berapa kali suatu hal telah terjadi (menjawab 'how much', 'how many', atau 'how many times'). Selain itu, kata kerja statif (seperti know, have untuk kepemilikan) umumnya tidak dipakai dalam bentuk continuous dan harus menggunakan bentuk simple, meskipun kata kerja seperti 'want' dan 'mean' bisa digunakan dalam Present Perfect Continuous.
explanation.pattern: Present Perfect Continuous: Subject + have/has + been + V-ing (Menekankan proses/durasi: how long) vs Present Perfect Simple: Subject + have/has + V3 (Menekankan hasil yang sudah tuntas/jumlah: how much, how many, how many times). Catatan: Verba statif (know, have = punya) menggunakan have/has + V3.
key_points: Continuous menekankan proses dan lamanya
Simple menekankan hasil atau jumlah

key_points: Setelah Do you know ...? / I wonder ... / Could you tell me ...?, urutannya subjek + verba tanpa do/does/did
Jika tidak ada kata tanya (what, why, dll.), pakai if atau whether: I wonder if she is at home
Pertanyaan dalam reported speech: asked/wanted to know + wh-/if + S + V (biasanya mundur ke past)

units.title: Auxiliary verbs; I think so / I hope so

explanation.summary: Auxiliary (have, do, can, was, dll.) bisa berdiri sendiri supaya verba utama tidak diulang: 'Have you finished?' 'Yes, I have.' Auxiliary juga dipakai untuk menyangkal ('Yes, I did!'), menunjukkan minat atau heran (Have you? / Isn't she?), dan bersama so/neither untuk berkata 'saya juga' (verba mendahului subjek). Untuk jawaban singkat dipakai I think so / I hope so / I'm afraid so; bentuk negatifnya I don't think so, tetapi I hope not / I'm afraid not.
explanation.pattern: S + aux (verba utama tidak diulang); So + aux + S; Neither/Nor + aux + S; I think so / I hope not
key_points: Auxiliary sama dengan kalimat asal dipakai agar tidak mengulang; present/past simple memakai do/does/did: 'Do you drive?' 'Yes, I do.'
So + auxiliary + subjek untuk hal positif, neither/nor + auxiliary + subjek untuk hal negatif (verba sebelum subjek): Rina passed, and so did Tono.
I think/expect so → negatif I don't think/expect so; I hope / I'm afraid / I guess / I suppose → negatif dengan not: I hope not (bukan I don't hope so)

explanation.summary: Question tag adalah pertanyaan mini di akhir kalimat, dibentuk dari auxiliary + pronomina; present dan past simple memakai do/does/did. Kalimat positif biasanya diikuti tag negatif dan sebaliknya. Intonasi turun berarti meminta persetujuan, intonasi naik berarti pertanyaan sungguhan (juga dipakai untuk meminta bantuan atau informasi dengan sopan). Kasus khusus: Let's … → shall we; perintah Don't … → will you; I'm … → aren't I.
explanation.pattern: positif + tag negatif (…, isn't it?); negatif + tag positif (…, do you?); Let's …, shall we?; I'm …, aren't I?
key_points: Tag memakai auxiliary yang sama dengan kalimatnya (is, have, will, can, should); present/past simple memakai do/does/did
Kalimat positif + tag negatif, kalimat negatif + tag positif; jawaban Yes/No mengikuti fakta sebenarnya: 'You aren't going out, are you?' 'No.' = tidak pergi
Intonasi turun = minta persetujuan, naik = pertanyaan nyata; Let's … → shall we?, Don't … → will you?, I'm … → aren't I?

explanation.summary: Beberapa verba selalu diikuti -ing, bukan to + infinitive, misalnya enjoy, mind, suggest, finish, stop, avoid, consider, admit, deny, imagine, risk, fancy, dan recommend. Frasa give up, put off, go on/carry on, serta keep (on) juga diikuti -ing. Bentuk negatifnya not + -ing. Bisa juga memakai pola verb + orang + -ing, dan untuk tindakan yang sudah selesai boleh memakai having + V3, meski -ing biasa sudah cukup.
explanation.pattern: enjoy/mind/suggest/finish/avoid + V-ing; give up/put off/keep on + V-ing; verb + objek + V-ing
key_points: Verba seperti enjoy, mind, suggest, finish, avoid, consider, admit, deny, imagine, fancy, dan risk diikuti -ing (bukan to …): I enjoy cooking.
give up, put off, go on/carry on, dan keep (on) juga diikuti -ing; negatifnya not + -ing: I enjoy not getting up early.
Bisa verb + orang + -ing (I can't imagine him dancing); untuk tindakan yang sudah selesai boleh having + V3, tetapi V-ing biasa lebih umum

key_points: want, expect, ask, help, would like, dan would prefer: verb + to + V1 atau verb + objek + to + V1; tidak dipakai 'want that + klausa'

explanation.summary: Sebagian verba hanya diikuti -ing (avoid, enjoy, finish, mind, suggest, stop, dll.), sebagian hanya diikuti to (decide, hope, plan, promise, refuse, dll.). Beberapa verba bisa diikuti keduanya dengan arti berbeda: remember doing (ingat sudah melakukan) vs remember to do (ingat lalu melakukan); regret doing (menyesal telah melakukan) vs regret to say/tell/inform (dengan menyesal menyampaikan); go on doing (melanjutkan hal yang sama) vs go on to do (beralih ke hal berikutnya). begin, start, continue, intend, dan bother bisa -ing atau to tanpa beda arti.

key_points: remember/regret + -ing → tindakan sudah terjadi (ingat / menyesal telah melakukan); remember + to → ingat lalu melakukan; regret to say/tell/inform → formal: dengan menyesal menyampaikan

explanation.pattern: like/love/hate + V-ing atau to V1; would like/love/hate/prefer + to V1; would mind + V-ing; would like to have + V3
key_points: like/love/hate untuk hal umum boleh -ing atau to; -ing untuk situasi yang sudah ada dan hal yang dinikmati, like to do = memilih melakukan
would like/love/hate/prefer + to + V1 (keinginan pada situasi tertentu); enjoy dan mind selalu -ing: Would you mind waiting?
would like/love/hate to have + V3 = sebenarnya ingin melakukannya tetapi tidak terlaksana

explanation.summary: Setelah see, hear, watch, feel, dan listen to, objek bisa diikuti V1 (tanpa to) atau V-ing. V1 berarti kita menyaksikan seluruh tindakan dari awal sampai selesai (I saw him cross the road). V-ing berarti kita menyaksikan tindakan yang sedang berlangsung, sebagian saja (I saw him crossing the road). smell dan find hanya dipakai dengan V-ing. + objek + V-ing = menyaksikan tindakan yang sedang berlangsung: I saw him crossing the road; smell dan find hanya dengan -ing
Jika perbedaannya tidak penting, keduanya bisa dipakai: I've never heard her sing / singing

units.title: by and until; by the time …

explanation.summary: by (paling lambat) dibanding until (terus sampai); by the time; in spite of dan despite.
explanation.pattern: by + waktu; until + waktu; despite + noun
key_points: By + waktu berarti paling lambat
Until berarti terus sampai; despite diikuti noun

examples.en: Despite the rain, we went out.
examples.id: Meski hujan, kami tetap keluar.

common_mistakes.wrong: Despite of the rain, we went out.
common_mistakes.correct: Despite the rain, we went out.

questions.prompt: I'll be at work ___ 6 pm, then I'll go home.
Please finish the report ___ Friday. (by/until)
Which is correct?
I stayed in bed ___ 10 o'clock. (until/by)
___ the time we arrived, the film had started.
Can you finish it ___ tomorrow morning? (by/until)
I will be working ___ 5 o'clock.
questions.explanation: "Until" berarti proses terus berlanjut sampai titik waktu tersebut.

questions.prompt: Please send me the report ___ (by) Friday.
questions.explanation: "By" berarti batas waktu maksimal (paling lambat hari Jumat).

questions.prompt: Complete: "___ (By/Until) the time we got to the cinema, the film had already started."
questions.explanation: Frasa "By the time" digunakan jika suatu kejadian sudah terlanjur terjadi pada batas waktu tersebut.

explanation.summary: Preposisi waktu at, on, in untuk jam, hari atau tanggal, dan bulan atau tahun.
explanation.pattern: at 5 pm; on Monday; in June
key_points: At + jam; on + hari atau tanggal
In + bulan atau tahun

examples.en: I was born in 1998.
examples.id: Saya lahir tahun 1998.

common_mistakes.wrong: I was born at 1998.
common_mistakes.correct: I was born in 1998.

questions.prompt: The meeting is ___ 3 pm.
She was born ___ 1995. (in/on)
We have a party ___ Saturday.
I'll see you ___ the morning. (in/on)
Choose the correct phrase.
He starts work ___ 8 o'clock. (at/on)
I usually wake up early ___ the morning.
questions.explanation: Bagian hari secara umum (morning, afternoon, evening) selalu menggunakan preposisi "in".

questions.prompt: We are meeting ___ Tuesday afternoon.
questions.explanation: Jika hari (Tuesday) disebutkan secara spesifik, preposisinya harus mengikuti hari, yaitu "on".

units.title: on time and in time; at the end and in the end

explanation.summary: on time (tepat waktu) dibanding in time (cukup cepat); at the end dibanding in the end.
key_points: On time: tepat waktu; in time: cukup cepat
At the end: di ujung; in the end: akhirnya

examples.en: We arrived in time for dinner.
examples.id: Kami sampai tepat waktu untuk makan malam.

common_mistakes.wrong: At the end I decided to stay.
common_mistakes.correct: In the end, I decided to stay.

questions.prompt: The train left ___ . It was exactly 8:00 as scheduled.
We got to the station ___ to catch the train. (in time/on time)
questions.explanation: In time berarti cukup cepat untuk sesuatu.

questions.prompt: ___ , we decided to stay home.
There was a party ___ of the course. (at the end/in the end)
questions.explanation: At the end of + kata benda.

questions.prompt: Which is correct?
options: I arrived just on the time.

questions.prompt: Don't worry, you'll get there ___ . (in the end/at the end)
The train left ___ (sesuai jadwal).
questions.explanation: "On time" berarti tepat pada waktu yang dijadwalkan (punctual/tidak telat).

questions.prompt: I got home just ___ to watch the match on TV.
questions.explanation: "In time" berarti dengan sisa waktu yang cukup untuk melakukan sesuatu / sebelum terlambat.

questions.prompt: Difference: "At the end of the film..." vs "In the end, we went home..."
options: "At the end" is used for time/location limits. "In the end" means finally/after a long time.
questions.explanation: "At the end" wajib diikuti "of" (at the end of January). "In the end" digunakan sendiri sebagai kesimpulan cerita.

questions.prompt: Fix the error: "In the end of the month, I will get paid."
questions.explanation: Setiap merujuk pada titik batas waktu (of the month), selalu gunakan "At".

explanation.summary: Posisi dengan in, at, on untuk lokasi, ruang, dan permukaan.
explanation.pattern: in the box; at the corner; on the shelf
key_points: In untuk ruang tertutup; on untuk permukaan; at untuk titik

examples.en: The keys are on the table.
examples.id: Kuncinya ada di meja.

common_mistakes.wrong: The keys are in the table.
common_mistakes.correct: The keys are on the table.

questions.prompt: The keys are ___ the table.
There's a picture ___ the wall. (on/in)
She lives ___ a small flat.
He's waiting ___ the bus stop. (at/in)
Which is correct?
There's a fly ___ the ceiling. (on/in)
I'll see you ___ Friday.
We are travelling ___ (in/at/on) October.
questions.explanation: Gunakan "in" untuk bulan, tahun, dan musim.

questions.prompt: Type the missing prepositions: "I usually wake up ___ 7 o'clock ___ the morning ___ Sundays." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Jam menggunakan AT, bagian hari (morning) menggunakan IN, hari spesifik (Sundays) menggunakan ON.

explanation.summary: Posisi lanjutan: kendaraan, tempat umum, dan acara.
explanation.pattern: in a car; on a bus; at the cinema
key_points: In a car, in a taxi
On a bus, on a train

examples.en: She is at work.
examples.id: Dia ada di tempat kerja.

common_mistakes.wrong: She is in work.
common_mistakes.correct: She is at work.

questions.prompt: She's ___ a taxi.
We were ___ the bus for an hour. (on/in)
He's ___ the airport. Waiting for his flight.
questions.explanation: At untuk tempat umum sebagai titik.

questions.prompt: I saw her ___ the cinema. (at/on)
Which is correct?
They live ___ the 5th floor. (on/in)
There's a spider ___ the ceiling.
Turn left ___ (at/in) the traffic lights.
questions.explanation: "At" digunakan untuk titik spesifik dalam perjalanan/lokasi.

questions.prompt: Type the missing prepositions: "He is waiting ___ the bus stop ___ the end of the street." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Keduanya adalah titik spesifik lokasi (bus stop dan ujung jalan), jadi gunakan AT.

explanation.summary: Posisi lanjutan: alamat, jalan, dan tempat tertentu.
key_points: On + nama jalan; at + nomor alamat
In + kota atau negara

examples.en: They live on Main Street.
examples.id: Mereka tinggal di Jalan Utama.

common_mistakes.wrong: They live in Main Street.
common_mistakes.correct: They live on Main Street.

questions.prompt: She lives ___ 12 Park Road.
The book is ___ page 20. (on/in)
My uncle lives ___ New York.
I saw him ___ the front of the queue. (at/on)
Which is correct?
options: on the corner of the room
in the corner of the room
at the corner of the room
questions.explanation: In the corner of a room.

questions.prompt: She sits ___ the back of the class. (at/in)
He is sitting ___ the back of the car.
questions.explanation: Untuk mobil dan taksi, gunakan "in the back".

questions.prompt: The answers are ___ (on/at) the back of the book.
Type the missing prepositions: "I saw him sitting ___ the back row of the cinema, right ___ the corner." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Dalam barisan (row) menggunakan IN. Untuk pojok ruangan dalam gedung (corner of a room) juga menggunakan IN.

explanation.summary: Arah dan posisi: to, at, in, into.
key_points: To berarti menuju; into berarti masuk ke dalam
Arrive in/at, bukan arrive to

examples.en: She walked into the room.
examples.id: Dia berjalan masuk ke ruangan.

common_mistakes.wrong: She walked in the room.
common_mistakes.correct: She walked into the room.

questions.prompt: She walked ___ the room.
We arrived ___ Jakarta yesterday. (in/to)
He went ___ the bank to get money.
They arrived ___ the hotel at midnight. (at/in)
Which is correct?
Welcome ___ our home! (to/into)
I read about it ___ the newspaper.
questions.explanation: Bahan bacaan cetak (buku, koran, majalah) menggunakan "in".

questions.prompt: I saw the news ___ (on/in) TV.
Type the missing prepositions: "We stayed ___ a nice hotel ___ a small island." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Hotel bisa AT/IN. Pulau selalu menggunakan ON.

explanation.summary: in, on, at dalam ungkapan tetap.
explanation.pattern: in cash; on holiday; at the weekend
key_points: Ungkapan tetap tidak bisa diganti preposisi lain
Hafalkan sebagai satu paket

examples.en: We paid in cash.
examples.id: Kami membayar tunai.

common_mistakes.wrong: We paid with cash.
common_mistakes.correct: We paid in cash.

questions.prompt: We paid ___ cash.
She is ___ holiday this week. (on/in)
I'll see you ___ the weekend.
I'm ___ a hurry. (in/on)
He is ___ the phone right now.
The shop is ___ sale this week. (on/in)
We walked ___ the city centre.
What time did you arrive ___ (in/to) London?
questions.explanation: "Arrive" tidak pernah menggunakan "to". Untuk kota besar atau negara, gunakan "in".

questions.prompt: Type the missing prepositions: "We went ___ a party ___ John's house." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Pergi menuju acara (TO). Lokasi terjadinya acara tersebut (AT).

explanation.summary: by untuk cara, sarana, dan pembuat.
key_points: By + transport tanpa the
By + pembuat karya

examples.en: I go to work by bus.
examples.id: Saya berangkat kerja naik bus.

common_mistakes.wrong: I go to work with bus.
common_mistakes.correct: I go to work by bus.

questions.prompt: I go to work ___ bus.
This book was written ___ a famous author. (by/with)
Which is correct?
She sent the letter ___ post. (by/with)
We went there ___ foot.
The picture was painted ___ Picasso. (by)
I'm going on holiday. I'll be away ___ business.
questions.explanation: Frasa baku: "on holiday", "on business", "on a trip".

questions.prompt: Water boils ___ (at) 100 degrees Celsius.
Type the missing prepositions: "Did you pay ___ cash or ___ credit card?" (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Uang tunai adalah "in cash", sedangkan metode pembayaran elektronik/kartu adalah "by credit card".

explanation.summary: Kata benda + preposisi tetap.
explanation.pattern: reason for; cause of; increase in
key_points: Noun punya preposisi tertentu
Contoh: reason for, cause of, increase in

examples.en: There's a reason for it.
examples.id: Ada alasan untuk itu.

common_mistakes.wrong: There's a reason of it.
common_mistakes.correct: There's a reason for it.

questions.prompt: There's a reason ___ everything.
The cause ___ the fire is unknown. (of/for)
There has been an increase ___ prices.
I need an answer ___ my question. (to/for)
Which is correct?
She has a lot of experience ___ teaching. (in/of)
We travelled ___ train.
questions.explanation: Transportasi umum tanpa kata sandang (the/a/my) menggunakan "by".

questions.prompt: We travelled ___ (in) my car.
questions.explanation: Jika ada kata "my/a/the" sebelum kendaraan pribadi (car/taxi), gunakan "in".

questions.prompt: Type the missing prepositions: "We went ___ train, but they went ___ their own car." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Tanpa the/my (by train). Ada awalan their (in their car).

explanation.summary: Adjektif + preposisi (bagian 1).
explanation.pattern: afraid of; interested in; good at
key_points: Adjektif tertentu butuh preposisi tertentu
Contoh: interested in, afraid of, good at

examples.en: I'm interested in history.
examples.id: Saya tertarik pada sejarah.

common_mistakes.wrong: I'm interested on history.
common_mistakes.correct: I'm interested in history.

questions.prompt: I'm interested ___ history.
She is afraid ___ spiders. (of/from)
He's very good ___ maths.
I'm proud ___ my son. (of/for)
Which is correct?
They are very different ___ each other. (from/of)
The cause ___ the fire is unknown.
There has been an increase ___ (in/of) prices.
questions.explanation: "Increase / decrease" (peningkatan/penurunan dalam hal tertentu) dipasangkan dengan "in".

questions.prompt: Type the missing prepositions: "She showed me a photograph ___ her family, and gave me an invitation ___ the wedding." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Foto seseorang = photograph of. Undangan menuju acara = invitation to.

explanation.summary: Adjektif + preposisi (bagian 2).
key_points: Kind to dan angry with dipakai untuk orang
Angry about dipakai untuk hal

examples.en: She was angry with me.
examples.id: Dia marah kepada saya.

common_mistakes.wrong: She was angry on me.
common_mistakes.correct: She was angry with me.

questions.prompt: She was very kind ___ me when I was ill.
I'm angry ___ him for being late. (with/at)
He is married ___ a doctor.
She's very similar ___ her mother. (to/with)
Which is correct?
options: I'm sorry about to be late.

questions.prompt: He is famous ___ his paintings. (for/of)
It was nice ___ you to help me.
questions.explanation: Untuk memuji perilaku seseorang, gunakan "nice / kind / good + OF + somebody".

questions.prompt: Are you angry ___ (with/about) me?
questions.explanation: Marah KEPADA seseorang = angry with/at somebody.

questions.prompt: Type the missing prepositions: "I was delighted ___ the present, but I felt sorry ___ the person who bought it." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Senang akan sesuatu = delighted with. Merasa kasihan pada = sorry for.

explanation.summary: Verb + to atau at.
key_points: Listen to dan talk to
Look at dan throw at

examples.en: Please listen to me.
examples.id: Tolong dengarkan saya.

common_mistakes.wrong: Please listen me.
common_mistakes.correct: Please listen to me.

questions.prompt: Please listen ___ me carefully.
Why are you looking ___ me like that? (at/to)
She talked ___ her boss about the problem.
Don't throw stones ___ the dog. (at/to)
questions.explanation: Throw at berarti melempar untuk mengenai.

questions.prompt: Which is correct?
I wrote a letter ___ my friend. (to/at)
I feel sorry ___ George.
questions.explanation: Sorry FOR somebody = kasihan pada seseorang.

questions.prompt: Are you excited ___ (about/for) going on holiday?
Type the missing prepositions: "I am impressed ___ her English, but I am not satisfied ___ the test results." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Kagum pada = impressed with/by. Puas dengan = satisfied with.

explanation.summary: Verb + about/for/of/after.
explanation.pattern: ask for; look after; think of
key_points: Look after berarti merawat
Ask for berarti meminta

examples.en: She looks after her grandmother.
examples.id: Dia merawat neneknya.

common_mistakes.wrong: She looks after to her grandmother.
common_mistakes.correct: She looks after her grandmother.

questions.prompt: She looks ___ her grandmother every day.
I'm looking ___ my keys. Have you seen them? (for/after)
Can I ask you ___ a favour?
What do you think ___ this idea? (of/for)
He's waiting ___ a bus.
She takes ___ her mother. They look alike. (after/for)
questions.explanation: Take after berarti mirip anggota keluarga.

questions.prompt: He apologised ___ the police officer.
questions.explanation: Meminta maaf KEPADA seseorang = apologise TO somebody.

questions.prompt: I don't care ___ (about/for) money.
Type the missing prepositions: "She explained the problem ___ us, and then apologised ___ being late." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Explain something TO somebody. Apologise FOR something.

explanation.summary: Verb + about atau of.
key_points: Talk about berarti membicarakan
Hear of atau about berarti mendengar tentang

examples.en: We talked about holidays.
examples.id: Kami membicarakan liburan.

common_mistakes.wrong: We talked about of holidays.
common_mistakes.correct: We talked about holidays.

questions.prompt: We talked ___ our holiday plans.
I've never heard ___ that band. (of/about)
questions.explanation: Hear of berarti tahu bahwa sesuatu ada.

questions.prompt: She dreamed ___ becoming a pilot.
He complained ___ the noise. (about/of)
Which is correct?
I'd like to tell you ___ my trip. (about/of)
I called the restaurant to ask ___ a table.
Does this umbrella belong ___ (to) you?
Type the missing prepositions: "I searched everywhere ___ my keys, but I didn't want to ask anyone ___ help." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Mencari sesuatu = search FOR. Meminta bantuan = ask FOR help.

explanation.summary: Verb + of/for/from/on.
explanation.pattern: depend on; die of; protect from
key_points: Depend on berarti tergantung
Die of dan protect from

examples.en: It depends on the weather.
examples.id: Itu tergantung cuaca.

common_mistakes.wrong: It depends of the weather.
common_mistakes.correct: It depends on the weather.

questions.prompt: It depends ___ the weather.
The soup smells ___ garlic. (of/from)
I'm saving money ___ a new laptop.
The doctor protected the patient ___ infection. (from/of)
Which is correct?
They live ___ rice and vegetables. (on/of)
They accused me ___ telling lies.
questions.explanation: Menuduh seseorang melakukan sesuatu = accuse somebody OF doing.

questions.prompt: I prefer tea ___ (to) coffee.
questions.explanation: Lebih memilih A daripada B = prefer A TO B.

questions.prompt: Type the missing prepositions: "He congratulated me ___ passing the exam, but he blamed the teacher ___ his own failure." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Selamat atas = congratulate ON. Menyalahkan orang atas sesuatu = blame somebody FOR something.

explanation.summary: Verb + in/into/with/to/on.
explanation.pattern: believe in; turn into; agree with
key_points: Believe in berarti percaya pada
Turn into dan agree with

examples.en: I agree with you.
examples.id: Saya setuju dengan kamu.

common_mistakes.wrong: I agree to you.
common_mistakes.correct: I agree with you.

questions.prompt: I believe ___ you.
The caterpillar turned ___ a butterfly. (into/in)
Do you agree ___ me?
She succeeded ___ passing the exam. (in/at)
Which is correct?
The glass broke ___ pieces. (into/in)
The book consists ___ 10 chapters.
Did you invite him ___ (to/for) the party?
Type the missing prepositions: "She spends a lot of money ___ clothes, but she never provides her children ___ enough food." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Menghabiskan uang untuk = spend money ON. Menyediakan sesuatu untuk seseorang = provide somebody WITH something.

explanation.summary: Pengantar phrasal verb: verb + partikel dengan makna idiomatis; posisi objek dan pronomina.
key_points: Phrasal verb adalah verb + partikel dengan makna khusus
Pronomina objek diletakkan di tengah

examples.en: Turn it off.
examples.id: Matikan itu.

common_mistakes.wrong: Turn off it.
common_mistakes.correct: Turn it off.

questions.prompt: Turn the TV ___ . It's too loud.
She picked ___ the book from the floor. (up/at)
Which is correct?
I don't know the word. Can I look it ___ ? (up/at)
questions.explanation: Look up berarti mencari di kamus.

questions.prompt: 'Give up' means...
He put his jacket ___ because it was cold. (on/off)
Can you turn ___ the radio? It's too quiet.
The car broke ___ (down) on the motorway.
Type the missing particle: "I had to fill ___ a form, and then hand it ___ to the receptionist." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Mengisi formulir = fill in/out. Menyerahkan = hand in.

explanation.summary: Phrasal verb dengan in dan out.
key_points: Come in, get out, check in
Maknanya sering harfiah

examples.en: Please come in.
examples.id: Silakan masuk.

common_mistakes.wrong: Please enter in.
common_mistakes.correct: Please come in.

questions.prompt: Please come ___ . The door is open.
At the airport, we had to check ___ two hours early. (in/at)
He got ___ of the car.
She filled ___ the form carefully. (in/out)
Which is correct?
options: I'll drop in on you tomorrow.
I'll drop in at you tomorrow.

questions.prompt: They moved ___ of the flat last week. (out/in)
I need to find ___ what time the train leaves.
Please put ___ (out/off) your cigarette.
Type the missing particle: "We tried to work ___ a solution, but eventually we had to give ___." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Mencari solusi = work out. Menyerah = give up.

explanation.summary: Phrasal verb dengan out.
key_points: Find out berarti mencari tahu
Run out of berarti kehabisan

examples.en: We ran out of milk.
examples.id: Kami kehabisan susu.

common_mistakes.wrong: We ran out milk.
common_mistakes.correct: We ran out of milk.

questions.prompt: I need to find ___ what time the train leaves.
We ran ___ of milk this morning. (out/off)
Can you work this problem ___ ?
The fire went ___ because of the rain. (out/off)
Which is correct?
He turned ___ to be a good friend. (out/up)
Look ___ ! There's a car coming.
We are looking ___ (forward) to our holiday.
Type the missing particle: "I don't get ___ well with my boss, so I try to keep ___ of his way." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Akur/berteman baik = get on well with. Menghindar = keep out of the way.

explanation.summary: Phrasal verb dengan on dan off (1).
key_points: Put on berarti mengenakan; take off berarti melepas
Turn on dan turn off untuk alat

examples.en: Take your shoes off.
examples.id: Lepas sepatumu.

common_mistakes.wrong: Put on it.
common_mistakes.correct: Put it on.

questions.prompt: Please turn ___ the light.
It's cold. Put your coat ___ . (on/off)
Take ___ your shoes before entering.
Switch ___ the computer before you leave. (off/on)
Which is correct?
She tried the dress ___ in the shop. (on/off)
Don't let me ___. I am relying on you.
I can't put ___ (up) with this noise anymore!
questions.explanation: "Put up with" berarti menoleransi/tahan terhadap sesuatu yang mengganggu.

questions.prompt: Type the missing particle: "He made ___ a story to explain why he was late, but I could easily see ___ his lies." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Mengarang cerita = make up. Menyadari kebohongan = see through.

explanation.summary: Phrasal verb dengan on dan off (2).
key_points: Set off berarti berangkat
Go on berarti melanjutkan

examples.en: We set off at dawn.
examples.id: Kami berangkat saat fajar.

common_mistakes.wrong: We went off at dawn.
common_mistakes.correct: We set off at dawn.

questions.prompt: We set ___ early to avoid traffic.
Please go ___ . I'm listening. (on/off)
The bomb went ___ at noon.
He got ___ the bus at the next stop. (off/out)
The alarm clock went ___ at 6 am.
Hold ___ ! I'm not ready yet. (on/off)
I ran ___ an old friend yesterday.
I can't make ___ (out) what it says. The writing is too small.
questions.explanation: "Make out" berarti bisa membaca/memahami secara visual atau audio dengan susah payah.

questions.prompt: Type the missing particle: "The meeting was put ___ until next week because the manager was held ___ in traffic." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Ditunda = put off. Tertahan = held up.

explanation.summary: Phrasal verb dengan up dan down.
key_points: Stand up dan sit down
Calm down dan slow down

examples.en: Please sit down.
examples.id: Silakan duduk.

common_mistakes.wrong: Calm you down.
common_mistakes.correct: Calm down.

questions.prompt: Please sit ___ .
He stood ___ when the teacher came in. (up/down)
Calm ___ . Everything will be fine.
The car broke ___ on the highway. (down/off)
Which is correct?
The prices went ___ last month. (down/off)
She takes ___ her father. They are very similar.
questions.explanation: "Take after" berarti mewarisi sifat/kemiripan fisik keluarga.

questions.prompt: A big company has taken ___ (over) our business.
Type the missing particle: "He took ___ swimming to lose weight, but gave it ___ after a week." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Memulai hobi/kebiasaan baru = take up. Berhenti/menyerah = give up.

explanation.summary: Phrasal verb dengan up (1).
key_points: Pick up berarti menjemput atau mengambil
Give up berarti menyerah atau berhenti

examples.en: I gave up sugar.
examples.id: Saya berhenti merokok.

common_mistakes.wrong: I gave away smoking.
common_mistakes.correct: I gave up smoking.

questions.prompt: I wake ___ at 6 every day.
She gave ___ smoking last year. (up/in)
Can you pick me ___ at the station?
Hurry ___ ! We're late. (up/on)
Please clean ___ your room.
They set ___ a new company last year. (up/off)
My alarm went ___ at 6 AM.
questions.explanation: "Go off" untuk alarm berarti berbunyi menyala.

questions.prompt: Please go ___ (on) with your story. I'm listening.
Type the missing particle: "The bomb went ___ in the city centre, and the police cordoned ___ the area." (Separate answers with a space)
questions.explanation: Meledak = go off. Menutup area dengan pita polisi = cordon off.

explanation.summary: Phrasal verb dengan up (2).
key_points: Grow up berarti menjadi dewasa
Come up with berarti mencetuskan ide

examples.en: Who came up with this idea?
examples.id: Siapa yang mencetuskan ide ini?

common_mistakes.wrong: Who came with this idea?
common_mistakes.correct: Who came up with this idea?

questions.prompt: He grew ___ in a small town.
Who came ___ with this idea? (up/out)
They made ___ after the argument.
She turned ___ at the party late. (up/in)
I can't keep ___ with you. You walk too fast.

explanation.summary:
Bahasa Inggris dan Bahasa Indonesia memiliki aturan dasar yang berbeda. Kesalahan paling umum yang dilakukan orang Indonesia adalah menerjemahkan kata per kata (direct translation).

Misalnya, kalimat nominal. Di bahasa Indonesia kita bisa bilang "Dia cantik", tapi di bahasa Inggris butuh "To Be" menjadi "She is beautiful".
explanation.pattern: Subject + To Be + Adjective/Noun (Bukan Subject + Adjective)
key_points: **Verbal vs Nominal:** Jika tidak ada kata kerja (makan, lari), wajib gunakan "To Be" (am, is, are, was, were).
**-ed vs -ing Adjectives:** "I am boring" berarti "Saya membosankan". Jika kamu merasa bosan, gunakan "-ed": "I am bored".
**Plurals (Jamak):** Jangan lupa akhiran -s/-es untuk benda lebih dari satu. "Many cars" bukan "Many car".

explanation.summary:
Dalam percakapan sehari-hari (spoken English), native speakers jarang mengucapkan kata secara penuh. Mereka menggunakan singkatan informal (*contractions*). Ini penting agar kamu bisa mengerti film, musik, dan percakapan kasual.

Contoh yang paling umum adalah Gonna (Going to), Wanna (Want to), dan Gotta (Got to / Have to).
explanation.pattern: Gonna = Going to | Wanna = Want to | Gotta = (Have) got to
key_points: **Gonna:** Digunakan untuk rencana masa depan. Hanya boleh digunakan setelah "To Be". Contoh: "I'm gonna sleep" (Benar). "I gonna sleep" (Salah).
**Wanna:** Artinya ingin. "I wanna go home".
**Gotta:** Artinya harus. "I gotta go now".

explanation.summary:
Untuk menguasai Tenses, jangan hafal rumusnya, tapi pahami LOGIKA WAKTU (Timeline)-nya.

Bahasa Inggris membagi waktu menjadi 3 garis besar: Masa Lalu (Past), Sekarang (Present), dan Masa Depan (Future). Lalu dibagi lagi karakternya: Simple (Fakta/Rutinitas), Continuous (Sedang terjadi), Perfect (Sudah terjadi, efeknya masih ada).
key_points: **Present Simple vs Continuous:** Simple untuk fakta permanen ("I live in Jakarta"). Continuous untuk kejadian sementara saat ini ("I am staying at a hotel").

**Past Simple vs Present Perfect:** Past Simple waktunya sudah selesai ("I lived in Paris in 2010"). Present Perfect kejadian di masa lalu tapi masih nyambung ke sekarang ("I have lived here for 5 years").
